**Tip SHA:** `17f9fcc26cb809e752a42ef2a48b71b0587d5c47`

### Change Summary

Single-file, test-only change: `src/services/__tests__/spc-angle.test.mts`.

The adversarial CDATA test spawns a child Node process with inline evaluated code. The prior tip omitted a `Date.now` override in that child, so the child's real wall clock (Nov 13, 2026) was 5+ days past the Nov 8 fixture timestamp — well beyond the provider's 48-hour freshness window — causing the child process to exit with status 1 instead of 0.

The fix prepends `Date.now=()=>${now};` to the child's code string, locking the child's clock to the same `now` fixture constant the parent test uses. This is the correct and minimal repair.

### Correctness

The fix is mechanically correct. The `now` constant in the parent test is the fixture timestamp. The child needs to share that reference to validate cache behavior against the same time axis. The 1-second post-READY deadline, 100,000-character adversarial payload, and all result assertions (`r.length!==1`, `r[0].description`, `result.ready`, `result.error===undefined`, `result.status===0`, `result.out.includes('DONE')`) are entirely preserved. No assertion weakening.

### Security

No production code touched. The child process already executed inline eval'd code via `node -e`; the new prefix only adds a `Date.now` mock using a numeric constant from the test fixture — no user input, no injection surface. No new dependencies, no credential handling. Prior Zizmor validation (`docs/validation/UX-066-ZIZMOR-VALIDATION.md`) remains valid; no new security surface was introduced.
